title: To better understand Banksy
text:
The guided tour is a good experience to get to know this street artist and the graffiti technique. He tells you about Banksy’s time in various countries and his contribution to art. Whether you want to or not we have all seen some Banksy work and this exhibition helps you to get to know him better. The guided tour was carried out by Inés who helped us to better understand the artist. 

In the graffiti painting workshop Elisa taught us how to spray work and paint a stencil of one of Banksy’s works that you then take home. A great experience and that I would recommend and repeat without a doubt.
author: Oscar_Traveller
